answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock: an agent stakes twice its 30-day earnings, locked for 20 epochs. Unlock needs a fingerprint: a pulse of tasks, varied counterparties and role-matching response times, peer-checked. Like yarrow, a fingerprint grows slowly, not overnight; a glacier of copies melts under audit: clones share timing. Forging 100 identities costs 100 stakes plus 100 histories; an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
